## Why quantize at all

Placeholder. This section will motivate the problem: embeddings are stored by
the million, a float32 vector costs four bytes per dimension, and at scale that
cost dominates everything else about a retrieval system.

## The rate/quality tradeoff

Placeholder. Every quantizer spends a bit budget and gives back some accuracy.
This section will introduce the curve the playground plots throughout — recall
against bits per dimension — and explain why a quantizer is only ever
interesting *relative* to what the same budget buys elsewhere.

## Pipelines of primitives

Placeholder. This section will describe the taxonomy the landing-page diagrams
use, and work through one composition end to end.

| Group | What it does | Examples |
|-------|--------------|----------|
| Conditioner | Reshapes the vectors before rounding | `center`, `normalize`, `rotate` |
| Rounder | Performs the actual quantization | `cast_angular`, `kmeans` |
| Splitter | Fans the vector into branches | `segment_split` |
